prompt: Set up OpenAI for my app writer on the gateway; its everyapp.config.ts lists the openai provider.

rules.name: no-account-yet
rules.reply: No, I don't have an OpenAI API account yet, and no key. Walk me through it.

rules.name: ran-curl
rules.reply: I exported the key in my own terminal and ran the curl. It printed {"object":"list","data":[{"id":"gpt-4.1","object":"model",... and no error. Then I ran unset OPENAI_API_KEY.

rules.name: created-key
rules.reply: Copied. I clicked Create secret key, copied it, and closed the dialog. It asked for my phone number first; the SMS code went through.

rules.name: credits-bought
rules.reply: Credits bought. The billing overview shows a $10 credit balance, and I turned auto-reload off.

rules.name: signed-in
rules.reply: Signed in. The dashboard at platform.openai.com is open and shows the Default project.

rules.name: default-project
rules.reply: The Default project is fine; I don't need a separate one.

rules.name: used-the-app
rules.reply: Opened the app and used the feature that calls OpenAI. It answered normally; no error, no x-everyapp-error header.
